pretreatment: cleaned in pure methanol and subjected to light etching in a 10% Br2—methanol solution
evidence: The wafer was cut from a bulk crystal which was grown by a modified Bridgman method. It was polished mechanically and oriented along the (111) crystal plane to within a high accuracy of ± 0.010. The wafer was then cleaned in pure methanol and subsequently subjected to light etching in a 10% Br2—methanol solution.
